relationships.subject: L-tetrahydropalmatine
relationships.evidence_quote: Alternative splicing events in clusters C1 and C3 may be influenced by THP treatment, potentially restoring the dysregulated splicing patterns associated with CCI injury.

relationships.subject: Grn
relationships.evidence_quote: Notably, the expression trend of Grn was consistent with the splicing trend of Nefh (Figure 4(C))

key_findings: CCI induces transcriptome-wide aberrant alternative splicing in rat spinal cord, enriched in synapse assembly and axonogenesis genes (e.g. Shank2, Nefh, Grid2); THP partially restores it.
RBPs including Rbm47, Grn, Lcp2, Plek, Ptpn6 and Hcls1 are upregulated in CCI and correlate with splicing events.
